description: Explicit, reviewable facts the KiCad schematic emitter may use to decide how a pin that the netlist does not connect is drawn, and which nets are fed from off-board. Every entry names the evidence it relies on. A pin the netlist connects is never given a no-connect, whatever this file says.

mcu_general_io.reason: Unused general-purpose I/O on a microcontroller board is normally left open.
